criteria.test: no essential rule of the reference lifecycle is SOURCE_BLOCKED or SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS, no reference rule rests on a secondary source only, and the source wording of the reference rules is available (not translation-only)
all nine operational phases run in the reference (no phase missing; a phase closed only by an SF6 model variant does not count)
no essential manual source decision is substituted by a model assumption in the reference (manual review requirement = none)
no essential rule of the reference is DATA_BLOCKED (proxies do not unblock)

V4-D1 containment: under DQ-K5 at most 1 % of the reference trades are directly exposed to a flagged session, and the DQ-K3 sensitivity is reported (undeclared 2:1 splits stay invisible to both: the dimension can never be better than PASS_WITH_DECLARED_LIMITS)
the reference ran on the frozen snapshot with research-v1, reconciled, deterministic, current code
entry and stop are executable point in time on the data used (no fill at a price unknown at the decision; no hypothetical short without borrow data); cost sensitivity measured

out-of-sample evidence on a window that was NEVER opened before the reference was fixed. A previously opened window (e.g. 2008-2015, opened once in R14) FAILS this criterion; it can at most earn PASS_WITH_DECLARED_LIMITS in the OUT_OF_SAMPLE_EVIDENCE dimension
